quotes.text: `nativeTime` is a signed 64-bit microsecond value; preserve it as a JSON-safe string and store expected recurrence strings once before `Assert.strictEqual`. `storeObserver` invokes `handleStateChange(fieldName, oldValue, newValue)` for every changed selector, so the mixin callback needs generic values until it filters `fieldName == "sourceSession"`. The recurrence browser test with a11y checks passed 88/88; the documentation-only mixin edit passed `node --check`, focused ESLint, and `git diff --check`. [Task 12]
